matches.rationale: Ground truth 1 concerns overstated claims in the Abstract about performance improvements. None of the findings address the Abstract or claims about performance improvements being overstated.

Ground truth 2 concerns fabricated future citations (2024-2025) in the Introduction. Finding 2 identifies uncited references but does not address the issue of citing future/speculative works as established literature.
Ground truth 3 concerns an incorrect closed-form formula in Proposition 1 (missing normalization/softmax). None of the findings address Proposition 1 or the formula in equation (6).
Ground truth 4 concerns missing data augmentation protocol details in the Experiments section. None of the findings address data augmentation or experimental protocol omissions.
Ground truth 5 concerns manipulated/truncated memorization metrics in Figure 2 and missing error bars. None of the findings address Figure 2, memorization metrics, or missing variance reporting.

Both address the same issue: Proposition 2's claim about unbiasedness of the Monte Carlo estimator. Ground truth 6 states the claim contradicts self-normalized importance sampling literature, while finding 1 identifies the contradiction between the text claiming approximate unbiasedness and Proposition 2 proving exact unbiasedness. These capture the same underlying inconsistency about the bias properties of the estimator.

Ground truth 7 concerns overly promotional language about 'modest but steady improvements' in the description of Figure 4. None of the findings address Figure 4 or rhetorical presentation issues in the Experiments section.

Ground truth 8 concerns contradiction between the Conclusion's claims about clarifying generalization and the Limitations section's admission of unexplored factors. None of the findings address this cross-section inconsistency between Conclusion and Limitations.
Ground truth 9 concerns insufficient discussion of privacy risks and mitigation in the Conclusion/Broader Impact section. None of the findings address ethical or privacy concerns.
Ground truth 10 concerns understated computational overhead claims in the Method section. None of the findings address computational efficiency claims or Algorithm 2's overhead.
Ground truth 11 concerns unreported/fabricated results for M ≥ 1000 in the Experiments section. None of the findings address missing experimental results or claims about M values above 1000.
Ground truth 12 concerns promotional language like 'remarkable agreement' and 'clearly answers' in the Related Work section. None of the findings address rhetorical issues in Related Work.

Ground truth 13 concerns contradictory narratives about stochasticity's importance between Section 3.1 and earlier sections. None of the findings address this cross-section inconsistency about the role of stochasticity.
